task.title: Allow verified read-only standby pair as rollback baseline

scope.owned_layer: Dev release rollback baseline capture in .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml to allow exact, verified read-only standby FE/BFF pair as outer rollback baseline without relaxing acceptance or enabling writes
composes_with: Dev environment lease coordination and rollback harness

behavioral_proof.accepted_baseline: Preserves exact accepted baseline behavior and baseline_source naming
behavioral_proof.standby_baseline: Allows deploymentState=standby only with exact schemaVersion=1, app=execute-plans, repository=ajoe734/execute-plans, sourceBranch=dev, bffCommitEvidence=True, matching bff baseUrl, exact non-conflicting SHA identities, read-only profile, strict live read-only buildMode (all write flags false), and valid matching releaseAdmission and agoraCompatibility pair bindings
behavioral_proof.fail_closed: Rejects any standby manifest with non-read-only profile, write-enabled buildMode, missing/mismatched releaseAdmission or agoraCompatibility, tampered repo/branch/identities, or invalid deploymentState
behavioral_proof.safe_defaults: Live capital actions disabled, source ingestion reconcile-only, nonprod deploy contract verified by 61 focused contract and unit tests
